description: For remodel scope, this completion sign-off form records demolition, new work, allowances, selections, exclusions, temporary conditions, sequence, and responsibility boundaries. Its supporting evidence includes existing-condition photos, measurements, sketches, investigation notes, product selections, and utility observations.

subtitle: Remodel Scope Completion Sign-Off Form: residential or commercial remodel scope definition using existing spaces, demolition, and existing-condition photos.
title: Remodel Scope Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during residential or commercial remodel scope definition when the remodel scope record must identify existing spaces, owner objectives, fixtures, finishes, structural interfaces, utilities, access, and occupied operations. Complete the applicable handoff for agreed scope, assumptions and exclusions, budget handoff, design questions, milestone plan, and owner acknowledgment.
